player_prompt.intro:
U ta vona {N} swiviko swa tingana swi hambanisiwa.
Eka xiyimo xin'wana u funza [accept] ku chukuta *value ya siku* hi yo, kuya fika [continue] ku i nyika na ku vona in'wana.
Loko u nga chuki hi nkarhi wun'we, u ta kuma value ya mwaha.
U winga (reward = 1) **nghena** loko value u yi chukule ku ri ya kule ya hinkwawo.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Xiendlo xi fanele ku va [accept] kumbe [continue].

outcome.summary: U a amukele value {value} eka draw {draw_num}/{N}. Leyi ntleke ku vona hinkwenu ku ri {best}. {result}
